siteDescription: Licensed plumbing for Puyallup and the surrounding Pierce County towns. Drains, water heaters, leaks and repipes. A demonstration business for the WebMCP challenge, with working booking tools.

footer.copyright: Clarks Creek Plumbing is a demonstration business built for the WebMCP challenge. The booking tools are real and meant to be used: holds, confirmations and the schedule all genuinely work. Nobody is dispatched to the address.
